title: Implement snapshot-bound non-authoritative Profile drafts
goal: Persist deterministic conservative Profile scaffolds below StateRoot without creating executable authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft identity binds project Target snapshot discovery and generator identities.
The candidate Profile is schema-valid conservative and visibly unprotected until policy is resolved.
Recommendations are labelled and do not silently select Modules gates severities exceptions rules or baselines.
Atomic idempotent StateRoot writes reject conflicts and never change TargetRoot.
risks: A generated draft could be mistaken for installed Profile authority.
decisions: Store drafts only below StateRoot and label empty coverage unprotected.
